periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Primary axis is oriented at approximately 60 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis, angled downwards toward the muzzle.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval shape with a vertical length approximately double the horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Substantial downward tapering with the lowest point extending further from the geometric center than the superior boundary.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: A wide gap is present between the ear regions, approximately equal to the horizontal width of the cranial vault between them.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Rounded, semicircular apex with smooth curvature across the superior boundary.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible white claws on the distal portion of the left forelimb.
